description: Calculate statutory late-payment interest (per half-year period), the fixed compensation for recovery costs and the total for an unpaid EU B2B invoice. Each number comes with its legal reference.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or null/"none" if no payment term was agreed (then 30 days after receipt)

eurPlnRate.description: Only for Polish law: NBP EUR/PLN average rate (last working day of the month before the due month)

lawCountry.description: Country whose late-payment law applies (default: creditorCountry)

receiptDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, date the debtor received the invoice (only used when there is no due date)

name: calc_claim
